test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**outhority**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is '**outhority**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Authority**'. • It means **'the power and right to give orders and make others obey'.** (अधिकार) • *Example: You must get this signed by a person in **authority**.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Editable**: (of text or software) in a format that can be edited by the user. ((पाठ या सॉफ्टवेयर का) एक प्रारूप में जिसे उपयोगकर्ता द्वारा संपादित किया जा सकता है) • **Meddle**: to take too much interest in somebody’s private affairs or to touch something that does not belong to you. (दूसरों के निजी मामलों में ज़रूरत से ज्‍यादा रुचि लेना या पराई चीज़ से छेड़-छाड़ करना; हस्‍तक्षेप करना) • **Condition**: the state that somebody/something is in. (अवस्‍था, दशा, स्थिति, हालत) 3c:Tbb1, The correct answer is '**popular**'.
